description: This file defines SwiftUI views and shapes for rendering chat messages in a chat UI, including chat bubbles with tails, message contents, attachment rows, tool call and result cards, typing indicators, and associated styles and constants.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: Custom shape for chat bubbles with optional tails (left, right, none). Defines path with rounded rect or tail shapes.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for rendering a chat message, including bubble shape, content styling, and layout.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Sub-view managing detailed message content, including markdown rendering, attachments, and tool results.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View to display an attachment within a chat message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View for displaying a tool call details within a message.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View for displaying a tool execution result, with toggle for detailed view.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View showing typing dots indicator for the assistant.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for displaying ongoing assistant response with markdown content.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: View indicating tools are running, showing a list of current tool calls.

classes.name: TypingDots
classes.description: Animated view of typing dots with accessibility considerations.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Sub-view rendering assistant’s message text with markdown and possibly thinking indicator.

methods.name: inset(by:)
methods.description: Inset the shape by a specified amount.

methods.name: path(in:)
methods.description: Create a Path for the shape within a given rectangle.

methods.name: rightTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Construct the tail shape on the right side of the bubble.

methods.name: leftTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Construct the tail shape on the left side of the bubble.

methods.name: addBottomEdge(path:bubbleMinX:bubbleMaxX:bubbleMaxY:radius:)
methods.description: Helper to add the bottom edge with curves to the tail shape.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Main view layout for various chat bubbles and components.

methods.name: updateAnimationState
methods.description: Control the animation of the typing dots based on environment and motion settings.
